mt: 项目: 目的: 批准者:

en: We ask for {col:funding.requested} and ask you to approve it under the budget code {col:funding.budget_code}. The request was made on {col:funding.requested_on}.
mt: 我们要求 {col:funding.requested} 并要求您在预算代码 {col:funding.budget_code} 下批准它.

en: You are invited to the kick-off of the project, which starts on {col:projects.start}. The project runs until {col:projects.end}.
mt: 我们邀请您参加项目启动,项目始于 {col:projects.start}.

en: Hello {owner}, your task {name} on {project} starts on {start}. Please confirm that you can begin and tell me about any blocker. Baseline end: {end}.
mt: 您的任务 {name} 在 {project} 开始于 {start}. 请确认您可以开始并告诉我任何阻塞器. 基线结束: {end}.

en: Hello {estimator}, please send your three-point estimate for {name} on {project}: best, likely and worst hours. The task estimate now is {task_hours} hours.
mt: 您好,请发送您在 {project} 上 {name} 的三点估计:最佳,可能和最糟糕的时间. 任务估计现在是 {task_hours} 小时.

en: Hello {staff}, your leave runs from {start} to {end} ({days} working days). You have {open_n} open tasks in that time. Please name your cover for each one before you go.
mt: 你的假期从1到2工作日. 在此期间,你有4个工作.请在离开之前给出你的身份.

en: Hello {staff}, your leave from {start} to {end} meets {rel_n} planned releases that you own. Please tell me who covers before you go.
mt: 您的假期从1到2月份符合您的计划.请在您离开之前告诉我谁是您的保险人.

en: Hello {manager}, the critical task {name} on {project} has {float_days} days of float and is {days_late} days late. Driver: {driver}. Action: {action}, due {due}.
mt: 您好,关键任务 {name} 在 {project} 有 {float_days} 天的浮动时间,并且延迟了 {days_late} 天. 驾驶员: {driver}. 行动: {action},到期 {due}.
